Definition: from G2453; Judaïc, i.e. resembling a Judæan:--Jewish.
BiblicalUsage: Jewish is the word Paul uses for the fables the Cretans were chasing. In Titus 1:14 he tells Titus not to give heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the warning still stands: fables dressed as religion turn men from the truth, and the truth is a Person, not a story.
